test_title: SSC Selection Post 2024 (Higher Secondary Level) Official Paper (Held On: 25 Jun, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Class X has 45 students scoring average marks of 30 and class Y has 35 students scoring average marks of 18. Find the average marks of the students of both classes together.
solution:
**Given:**

Class X has 45 students scoring average marks of 30

Class Y has 35 students scoring average marks of 18

**Formula used:**

Combined Average Marks = dfrac{{Total Marks of Class X} + {Total Marks of Class Y}}{{Total Students of Class X} + {Total Students of Class Y}}<
